world.scenario: You wake in a decaying mansion, the air thick with the scent of old blood and damp wood. A murder has been committed, and the house is cursed — its corridors twist unnaturally, its doors open only to those who solve its riddles. As the final heir to the family, you must uncover the truth behind the murder before the house consumes you forever.
world.objective: Uncover the truth of the murder and escape the cursed mansion before the house claims your soul.

rooms.description: The entry hall is cold and still, the scent of mildew clinging to the air like a forgotten memory. A single chandelier hangs from the ceiling, its crystals dark and cracked, casting jagged shadows across the stone floor.

The parlor is dim and heavy with the scent of aged wine and something more acrid — something metallic. A grand piano sits in the center, its lid slightly open, revealing a sheet of music stained with what looks like dried blood.

The study is silent except for the whisper of wind through a cracked window, carrying the scent of burnt paper and old ink. A desk sits center stage, its drawers all locked, but one drawer is slightly ajar, revealing a stack of yellowed letters.

The attic is a graveyard of forgotten things — the air is thick with the smell of mildew and old leather. A chandelier dangles from the ceiling, its chains rusted and dangling, and a broken mirror hangs askew, reflecting distorted shadows.

The crypt is cold and silent, lit only by a single flickering candle. The walls are lined with stone coffins, their lids sealed with rusted iron clasps. A heavy iron door stands at the far end, its surface engraved with the family crest and a symbol you do not recognize.

rules: Agent only reveals information already discovered in the game state.
Codes and numbers must come from the game state, never invented.
If information is not yet found, agent must say 'not yet known' instead of guessing.
Actions are only valid if the object is visible and within reach.
